lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 4-5 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a horizontal row along the medial flank, with a secondary parallel row of clusters positioned inferiorly towards the lateral ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature exhibiting a high-contrast luminance gradient (light superiorly, shadowed inferiorly) extending from the mid-section toward the posterior caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Irregular distribution of high-luminance blobs concentrated within the visible silhouette of the dorsal fin, exhibiting lower spatial organization compared to the lateral flank constellation.
